data.explanation: The platform classified the market as RANGE with 0.68 confidence and recorded a reclaim of session VWAP on BA accompanied by volume roughly 1.8 times its trailing average. Three configured rules fired in support and two fired against: the instrument is trading near the top of its Bollinger channel, and in a RANGE regime this pattern has historically resolved FLAT more often than it has resolved UP. The model assigns 0.44 to UP, 0.33 to FLAT and 0.23 to DOWN over the 60-minute horizon with a flat band of plus or minus 18 basis points, so the most likely single outcome carries less than even odds and both other outcomes remain plausible. The risk engine allowed a paper signal with two warnings recorded.
